Bay Atlas

Every training site and public landmark in Bay World, with the programmes it anchors and a link into each — over the world's own map, or over a real-world map when you bring a Mapbox public token. Bay World is stylised and not to scale; the real-world placement is an approximate fit, good enough for a map and nothing more. Back to Bay World.

Nothing is sent to Mapbox until a token exists; with one, the library is fetched from cdnjs and each map request carries the token. A deployment can also set mapboxToken in auth-config.json, or pass ?mapbox= on the launch URL for one tab. Details and where this works: docs/mapbox.md.
